title: Theft of home contents
text: Report theft to the police within 48 hours and keep the police report number. Contents claims need a list of the stolen items with purchase receipts or photos where available. Claims are usually assessed within 10 working days of receiving the documents.

title: Water damage and leaks
text: Sudden and unforeseen leaks are covered under the home contents and buildings policies. Damage caused by gradual wear, poor maintenance or condensation is not covered. In an emergency you may call a plumber directly; emergency repair costs up to EUR 500 are reimbursed without prior approval.

title: Change of address
text: You can change your address online in the customer portal or through customer service. Your premium may change because the risk profile of the new address is different. A new policy schedule is sent within 5 working days.

title: Premium payment and direct debit
text: Premiums are collected by direct debit on the first working day of the month. A failed collection is retried after 7 days. No late fee is charged if the premium is paid within 14 days of the payment reminder.

title: Refunds after cancellation
text: When a policy is cancelled, the premium for the unused period is refunded pro rata within 10 working days to the bank account used for the direct debit.

title: Complaints procedure
text: Complaints are acknowledged within 2 working days and answered within 6 weeks. If you disagree with the outcome you can take the complaint to Kifid, the Dutch financial services complaints institute, within 3 months of our final response.

title: Car accident claims
text: Report a car accident within 5 days using the European accident statement form signed by both drivers. With comprehensive cover you are entitled to a courtesy car while your car is being repaired at an approved garage.

title: Adding or removing cover
text: Cover can be added or removed at any time. Adding a family member to a policy requires their date of birth and, for car insurance, their driving licence number. Changes take effect from the next day.

title: Travel insurance emergency assistance
text: The emergency assistance line is available 24/7 for medical emergencies abroad, lost documents and repatriation. Call the assistance line before arranging hospital treatment so that costs can be guaranteed directly to the hospital.
